summary: No reachable vulnerabilities. Style JSON is bundled authored data, validated at import and failing closed: deviations must be an array; each entry must match a fixed allow-list of street/advice/instead triples (non-records coerced to {} and rejected); duplicates rejected; probability must be a finite number in [0,1]; justification word-count enforced; untrusted values echoed in errors truncated to 20 chars. Worker dispatch in src/table/advice-service.ts is a strict equality check (style === 'Calling station'); any other or tampered style string falls through to decideTag, so a request can't select unintended code. decideCallingStation reads only the bot's PlayerView (own seat's streetContribution, currentBet, legalActions) and draws only from the injected seeded Xoshiro generator via drawDeviation; no Math.random/Date. The non-CSPRNG is deliberate (reproducibility) and only drives bot style, not dealing. No new dependencies, secrets, or injection sinks.
